episodeTitle.en: Pattern Breakers: How to find a breakthrough startup idea | Mike Maples, Jr. (Partner at Floodgate)
episodeTitle.zh: 《破局者：如何找到突破性创业理念》 | 小迈克·马普尔斯（Mike Maples, Jr.，Floodgate合伙人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Mike Maples, Jr. is a legendary early-stage startup investor and a co-founder and partner at Floodgate. He’s made early bets on transformative companies like Twitter, Lyft, Twitch, Okta, Rappi, and Applied Intuition and is one of the pioneers of seed-stage investing as a category. He’s been on the Forbes Midas List eight times and enjoys sharing the lessons he’s learned from his years studying iconic companies. In his new book, Pattern Breakers: Why Some Start-Ups Change the Future, co-authored with Peter Ziebelman, he discusses what he’s found separates startups and founders that break through and change the world from those that don’t. After spending years reviewing the notes and decks from the thousands of startups he’s known over the past two decades, he’s uncovered three ways that breakthrough founders think and act differently. In our conversation, Mike talks about: • The three elements of breakthrough startup ideas
guestBioOfficial.zh: 小迈克·马普尔斯（Mike Maples, Jr.）是传奇的早期阶段创业投资人，也是Floodgate的联合创始人及合伙人。他早期投资了推特、Lyft、Twitch、Okta、Rappi和Applied Intuition等变革性公司，是种子期投资领域的先驱。他八次入选《福布斯米达斯榜单》，乐于分享多年研究标志性公司的经验。在与彼得·齐贝尔曼（Peter Ziebelman）合著的新书《破局者：为何有些创业公司能改变未来》中，他剖析了突破性创业公司与未能突破、改变世界的创业公司之间的差异。通过研究过去20年间认识的数千家初创公司的笔记和演示文稿，他发现了突破性创业者在思维和行动上的三个不同之处。在对谈中，迈克探讨了：• 突破性创业理念的三个要素

title.en: Pattern Breakers: How to find a breakthrough startup idea | Mike Maples, Jr. (Partner at Floodgate)
title.zh: 《破局者：如何找到突破性创业理念》 | 小迈克·马普尔斯（Mike Maples, Jr.，Floodgate合伙人）

summary.en: Mike argues breakthrough startups win through asymmetric warfare enabled by inflections, insights, and founder-future-fit, not by out-executing incumbents. He explains that 80% of his biggest returns came from pivots and that startups should propose a radically different future. The episode is a deep framework for spotting and backing category-defining companies.
summary.zh: 迈克认为，突破性的初创公司靠"拐点、洞见与创始人与未来的契合"发起不对称战争取胜，而非靠比巨头执行得更好。他说明，自己 80% 的最高回报来自转型，且初创公司应提出截然不同的未来。本期是一套用于识别并押注"定义品类"公司的深度框架。
